# story time of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:storyTimeOf`](gmeow-storyTimeOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/storyTimeOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Anchors a story-time frame to the narrative reference frame (canon, continuity) whose in-universe chronology it coordinatizes. Functional: one anchoring per frame; competing continuities carry their own story-time frames, and the same event may hold different story positions in each ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:NarrativeTimeFrame`](../classes/gmeow-NarrativeTimeFrame.md) -> [`gmeow:NarrativeReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-NarrativeReferenceFrame.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:storyTimeOf`](gmeow-storyTimeOf.md) from [`gmeow:NarrativeTimeFrame`](../classes/gmeow-NarrativeTimeFrame.md) to [`gmeow:NarrativeReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-NarrativeReferenceFrame.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
